title: Final Angle Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The angle alpha' must be correctly calculated using the tangent of the ratio of the y and x components of the package's velocity in the frame of ship (1).

title: Final Speed Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The speed of the package in the frame of ship (1) must be correctly calculated using the Pythagorean theorem for the components of velocity.

title: Velocity Component Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and calculate the y-component of the package's velocity needed to match ship (2)'s position.

title: Velocity Transformation Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the velocity transformation equations to find the components of the package's velocity in the frame of ship (1).

title: Unit Consistency Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all velocities are expressed in consistent units, typically in terms of c.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when applying the velocity transformation, particularly with the direction of motion.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing factors in the velocity transformation equations that could lead to incorrect results.
